scripts.org:login: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); const alias = process.env.SF_TARGET_ORG || 'myCapstoneOrg'; const instanceUrl = process.env.SF_INSTANCE_URL || 'https://login.salesforce.com'; execSync(`sf org login web --alias ${alias} --instance-url ${instanceUrl}`, { stdio: 'inherit' });"
scripts.org:setup: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); const alias = process.env.SF_TARGET_ORG || 'myCapstoneOrg'; execSync(`sf config set target-org=${alias}`, { stdio: 'inherit' });"
scripts.org:deploy: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); const alias = process.env.SF_TARGET_ORG || 'myCapstoneOrg'; execSync(`sf project deploy start --source-dir force-app/main/default --target-org ${alias}`, { stdio: 'inherit' });"
scripts.org:open: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); const alias = process.env.SF_TARGET_ORG || 'myCapstoneOrg'; execSync(`sf org open --target-org ${alias}`, { stdio: 'inherit' });"
scripts.org:status: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); const alias = process.env.SF_TARGET_ORG || 'myCapstoneOrg'; execSync(`sf org display --target-org ${alias}`, { stdio: 'inherit' });"
scripts.org:assign-permset: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); const alias = process.env.SF_TARGET_ORG || 'myCapstoneOrg'; execSync(`sf org assign permset --name Job_Application_Manager --target-org ${alias}`, { stdio: 'inherit' });"
scripts.setup:complete: npm run org:setup && npm run org:deploy && npm run org:assign-permset
